questions.question: You have received an email from your friend Sam about a local sports event. Read Sam's email and the notes you have made. Write an email to Sam answering all the notes. (100 words) Notes: 1. Yes, sounds great! 2. Suggest meeting at the park entrance. 3. Mention the ticket price. 4. Ask about the time.
questions.explanation: Write an email responding to all four points provided in the notes.

questions.question: Choose ONE of the following tasks: Option 1: Write an article for a school magazine about 'A sport I love'. Tell us why you like it and how often you play it. Option 2: Write a story that begins with the sentence: 'The crowd went quiet as the match began.'
questions.explanation: Write either an article or a story based on the prompts provided.
